name: Vincent van Gogh
bio: Dutch Post-Impressionist master whose emotionally evocative, bold impasto brushwork laid the foundation for modern 20th-century art.

name: Claude Monet
bio: Pioneering founder of French Impressionism, dedicated to expressing one's perceptions before nature, especially through en plein air light studies.

name: Gustav Klimt
bio: Leading Austrian Symbolist painter and president of the Vienna Secession, famed for his Golden Phase decorated with gold leaf and erotic allegories.

name: Johannes Vermeer
bio: Dutch Golden Age painter who achieved unmatched luminosity, spatial serenity, and psychological intimacy in modest domestic scenes.

name: Leonardo da Vinci
bio: Supreme Italian Renaissance polymath whose sfumato rendering, scientific anatomical precision, and universal curiosity epitomised humanist genius.

name: Pierre-Auguste Renoir
bio: Celebrated French Impressionist who celebrated feminine beauty, convivial outdoor celebrations, and warm sun-drenched camaraderie.

name: Rembrandt van Rijn
bio: Dutch Baroque titan renowned for uncompromising emotional honesty, penetrating self-portraits, and incomparable mastery of shadow and light.

name: Katsushika Hokusai
bio: Edo-period Japanese artist and printmaker whose Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji transformed Eastern landscape art and inspired European modernism.
